{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Count total rows
total_rows = len(df)
print(f'Total rows in dataset: {total_rows}')

# Count duplicate patient_id values
duplicate_patients = df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum()
print(f'Duplicate patient_id count: {duplicate_patients}')

# Number of re-tested patients (each contributes 1 duplicate)
retested_patients = duplicate_patients // 2
print(f'Number of re-tested patients: {retested_patients}')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients after deduplication
unique_patients = len(df_dedup)
print(f'Unique patients after deduplication: {unique_patients}')"}
